text: Davis and his family own an estimated 95% of the privately held company (New Balance); Jim Davis bought a small Boston shoemaker in 1972 and is its chairman.
short: New Balance is privately held; Jim Davis and his family own an estimated 95%.

source.name: Forbes - Jim Davis & family profile
source.quote: Davis is the chairman of New Balance, and his wife Anne, who joined the company in 1977, is the vice chairman. Davis and his family own an estimated 95% of the privately held company.
